info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Wholesale Trading Dealer Desk API
info.description: The Wholesale Trading Dealer Desk API allows financial institutions to update and manage dealer desk records. This API facilitates modifications to trading parameters and configurations, ensuring that dealer operations remain efficient and accurate. It targets brokers and financial analysts who need to adjust trading strategies based on market conditions or compliance requirements. By leveraging this API, users can enhance their trading workflows and maintain up-to-date information in their systems.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication scheme, where a JSON Web Token (JWT) is used for authentication.
